units.source_text: 以上所述，是源氏三十五岁上九月中之事。

en.t: What has been described above took place around the ninth month, when Genji was thirty-five years old.

units.source_text: 玉鬘迁入六条院一事，不能立刻实行，先要访得几个优良的女童和青年侍女。

en.t: The plan to move Tamakazura into the Rokujo estate could not be carried out at once; first they had to find several suitable young girls and young waiting women.

units.source_text: 在筑紫时，有些面貌端正的侍女从京都流离到该地，乳母家便托人介绍，雇用了几名来服侍玉鬘。

en.t: When they were in Tsukushi, some presentable waiting women had drifted there from the capital, so the nurse's household asked for introductions and hired several of them to serve Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 后来仓皇逃出之时，此等侍女都不曾带走，所以现在一个人也没有。

en.t: Later, when they fled in haste, none of those waiting women were brought along, and so now there was not a single one left.

units.source_text: 京中地广人多，有些女商之类的人，顺利地找得了几个侍女，给送上门来。

en.t: The capital was vast and crowded, and some women brokers and others of that sort were able to find several waiting women without difficulty and bring them to the house.

units.source_text: 对于这些新来的侍女，都不让她们知道小姐是谁家的女儿。

en.t: None of these newly arrived waiting women were allowed to know whose daughter the young lady was.

units.source_text: 先把玉鬘悄悄地带到五条地方右近家里，在这里选定了侍女，备办了装束，然后于十月中迁入六条院。

en.t: First Tamakazura was quietly taken to Ukon's house in the Gojo area; there they chose her attendants and prepared her clothing, and then in the tenth month she moved into the Rokujo estate.
